model.hymt.desc: Lightweight translation model. Runs great on pure CPU and 2 GB VRAM GPUs.
model.qwen.desc: High translation quality, slang and lore understanding. Recommended 6–8 GB VRAM.
model.sakura.desc: Specialized AI for Japanese visual novels and manga with anime honorifics support.
hint.engine.google: Google online service. Internet required, good quality.
hint.engine.mymemory: MyMemory online service. Request limits apply, average quality.
hint.engine.opus: Local Opus-MT model (~300 MB). Only en→ru, works offline.
hint.engine.nllb: Local NLLB-200 model (~2.5 GB). Works offline, higher quality.
hint.engine.qwen: Local neural network (GGUF). Runs 100% offline on your GPU or CPU via llama.cpp.
hint.ocr.windows: Native Windows 10/11 system engine. Blazing fast (~15 ms), 0 MB VRAM.
hint.ocr.rapidocr: Lightweight ONNX engine. High accuracy on stylized fonts, kanji, and manga.
app.title: ScreenTale
app.running_background: Application is running in the background
sidebar.mode_chat_tip: «Chat Window» — classic floating window with history and scroll.
sidebar.mode_inplace_tip: «In-Place» — native AR text replacement over the game (Right Click dismisses).
ui.general.outline_hint: Thin dark contour around letters for 100% readability on bright/snowy backgrounds.
ui.general.autocopy_hint: Translation result is always available via Ctrl+V.
ui.general.streamer_hint: When enabled — overlay is visible only to you, hidden from streams and screenshots.
ui.trans.gpu_hint: Switching restarts OCR engine. CUDA required.
ui.hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
ui.hotkeys.hint: Click a button and press a new combination. Esc — cancel. Requires Ctrl or Alt (or F-key).
ui.adv.threads_hint: Dedicated CPU cores for local AI. 'Auto' leaves half the cores for OS and games.
ui.adv.delay_hint: Pause for text stabilization before sending for translation (200–2000 ms).
ui.adv.verbose_hint: Writes full uncropped OCR and translation text to app.log.
ui.about.title: About ScreenTale
ui.about.thanks_text: To the chief tester — for resilience, courage, and suffering in version 0.4.
ui.trans.gpu_cuda_missing: CUDA not detected — CPU mode only
ui.trans.cache_tooltip:
In Windows, cache may duplicate files and accumulate old revisions of weights.
The 'Clear All Cache' button allows you to easily reset all accumulated duplicates.
sidebar.pin_game_tip: Bind overlay to a game window (Auto-hides on Alt-Tab)
